claims.statement: Repository toolchain requires Node 24 or newer and pnpm 10 or newer, pins pnpm 11.25.0 via packageManager with Corepack activation and frozen lockfile, and both general CI setup and scheduled wiki CI run on Node 24 with pnpm 11.25.0.
All pnpm wiki scripts preload openwiki-fetch-patch via node import before invoking the pinned openwiki CLI, with wiki update print as the non-interactive command CI runs.

Inference must use OPENWIKI_PROVIDER openai-compatible against opencode inference base with model muse-spark-1.3-contributor and USE_RESPONSES_API true; false routes to chat completions and fails as ModelProtocolUnsupported surfaced as HTTP 401.

Fetch-patch injects mandatory x-opencode-session header only for opencode requests, reusing the override when valid, deriving a deterministic per-run hash in GitHub Actions, generating a random value locally, and never overwriting an existing header.

Scheduled wiki CI triggers daily at 08:00 UTC plus workflow_dispatch, checks out full git history so openwiki code --update can diff, installs with frozen lockfile, and runs code --update --print with continue-on-error to preserve partial pages.

Wiki CI produces docs-only PRs limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md when present, excludes workflow-file changes and transient openwiki/.run.json, validates the numeric PR number, and merges with --merge --admin on success because squash is disabled and auto-merge would wait on the required code-owner review that the bypass actor skips.

Secrets are never committed: local runs use untracked .env copied from .env.example, CI maps OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY secret to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY, and PR creation and merge require dedicated OPENWIKI_PR_TOKEN with Contents and Pull requests write because default GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger pull_request workflows.

Submission layout requires repository with README, .env.example, AGENTS.md, data loader and transform scripts without large re-downloadable files, semantic dictionary, policies RBAC and masking, skills, evals questions and EX grader plus runner, and docs diagrams, plus technical report, ownership table, at most 15-minute demo video, and one sample trace per UC; the harness implements the data contract in packages/data/src with publisher cache and seeded signals kept out of the wiki index.

PRD allows Python (recommended) or TypeScript with LangGraph (recommended) or a justified equivalent, and the implemented harness uses TypeScript with LangGraph.js plus MCP and Postgres 16 with pgvector.

Coding agents must treat generated wiki as optional just-in-time context with source as authoritative, respect the openwikiignore read boundary including data dumps and secrets, and prefer updating source over hand-editing generated pages.

Root quality gate is pnpm typecheck (tsc -b over seven tsconfig.json project references with strict ESM nodenext base), pnpm lint (eslint . with no-restricted-imports guards on agent, access-policy, api, and web), and pnpm test (tsc -b plus vitest run over contracts, agent, mcp-server, access-policy, data, api, and web projects).
pnpm docs:interface regenerates docs/mcp_interface.md from frozen @shared/contracts Zod schemas via tsx scripts/generate-interface.mjs and the output must never be hand-edited.

Pnpm workspace declares build approvals true for better-sqlite3 esbuild and launchql protobufjs and false for lang-core, defines apps and packages globs, holds shared catalog plus overrides pins and minimumReleaseAgeExclude.

Operator entrypoints are db up and db reset for loopback database, docker wrappers plus profile-gated data service, data load full default and small CI variant sharing FK graph, data verify per-scale manifest, plus demo tracer trace show eval skills check and external client.

Database is Postgres 16 plus pgvector bound loopback-only on 127.0.0.1 port 5433 with pgdata and initdb volumes and pg_isready healthcheck; dev passwords must match initdb roles and must never leave loopback development.

Gateway authorization uses per-role bearer tokens resolved through tokenEnv names in policies/mcp_clients.yaml with scope and row-scope predicates, while sensitive columns customers phone, email, address and employees salary are rewritten or blocked before execution and PII is redacted in outputs and traces.

Adding a workspace package requires catalog references, tsconfig project-reference coverage, workspace star links and dist entrypoints, and extension of enumerated ESLint guards so the new package cannot bypass DB and contract boundaries.

General CI splits the root gate into typecheck lint policy with workspace and skills checks, unit test, docs interface drift, live database with small load plus verify plus role and gateway live tests, and gitleaks secrets jobs behind one required gate check.

Workspace invariants pin CONTRACTS_VERSION to the packages/contracts package version so additive contract changes need one code-owner review and breaking changes need a major bump plus agreement from affected owners.

skills:check fails on any executable file under skills/ and on key blocks, URLs, or DSN strings, validates eight canonical declarative-skill headings when skills exist, and passes with a no-skills-yet message otherwise.
Demo tracer proves the full gateway pipeline from bearer-token auth through scope zod sqlGuard AccessPolicy executor PII scan and audit over Streamable HTTP without shortcuts.
On OpenWiki failure the workflow disables auto-merge for the docs PR, annotates the PR URL with a notice, and propagates the failure with exit 1.

.github/CODEOWNERS requires approval from @NDTruongDanh or @HungPham-VNU on every change, with @nguyenhun11 as third owner on contracts, agent, api, skills, and evals, plus per-path owners covering mcp-server, access-policy, web, policies, data, docker, semantic, validators, subgraphs, UC-02/UC-03 tests and traces, and chart files.

ruleset-main.json protects main with deletion and non-fast-forward blocks, one code-owner review with stale-review dismissal and required thread resolution, and a single required gate status check with bypass actors for docs-only automation.

Branch protection lists merge, squash, and rebase as allowed merge methods while the openwiki-update workflow merges docs-only PRs with gh pr merge --merge --admin --delete-branch after validating the PR number.

pr-review.yml runs an advisory architecture review on pull requests into main for opened, synchronize, reopened, and ready_for_review events, skipping drafts, with per-PR cancel-in-progress concurrency and contents-read plus pull-requests-write permissions.

The pr-review job reuses the OpenWiki OpenCode Go key over the Responses API with muse-spark-1.3-contributor at xhigh reasoning effort and a mandatory x-opencode-session header, and it is explicitly non-blocking so API or key failures exit zero instead of failing gate.

scripts/pr-review.mjs diffs base...HEAD against docs/architecture.md as the source of truth, excludes lockfile, openwiki, dist, coverage, and log paths, truncates oversized diffs, and maintains one living marker comment stamped with the reviewed commit; missing keys, fork PRs, empty diffs, and API failures post skip or error notices without blocking gate.

Eval-only registry clients are validated for shape and uniqueness then dropped, so no persona resolves to them and boot never requires their bearer token; the eval scope token is only needed for pnpm eval gateways started with MCP_ENABLE_EVAL_CLIENTS=1.

AppStateStore owns a capped two-connection pool over alert history with SHA-256 canonical fingerprints, hasFingerprint 24-hour dedup check, and write-after-send recordSent using ON CONFLICT conditional update so expired windows update in place.
Direct API host execution defaults to API_PORT 3001, MCP_PORT 8081, TRACES_DIR traces, and derives MCP_URL as http://127.0.0.1:{MCP_PORT}/mcp when MCP_URL is unset.
